findings.name: periodAmount
findings.disposition_and_reason: Not applicable: (amount / scale) * scale deliberately floors contractual interest to the underlying asset unit after the full-precision interest calculation; scale is validated. findings.name: creditRecovery
findings.disposition_and_reason: Not applicable: units is the measured surplus clamped to the incident recovery capacity. Zero means there is nothing to credit and correctly reverts; any positive amount is accepted within the cap, so an unsolicited donation cannot prevent recovery by breaking an exact target balance.
